_meta.purpose: Initial RSI Hermes ship + zone definitions.
_meta.axis_convention: Width = port-to-starboard (X). Length = rear-ramp-edge to forward (Y). Height = floor up (Z). All units are 1.25 m cubes.
_meta.ramp_note: Single rear ramp. All bays load via low-Y (rear) end. Ship-forward direction is high-Y.
_meta.load_doctrine_note: Eight bays in four side-by-side columns. Each column is one continuous open bay split into a Rear half (R, at low-Y) and a Forward half (F, behind it at high-Y). To access F the loader walks past R first. Loading direction = walk forward, deepest first: F1-F4 load FIRST (and unload LAST), R1-R4 load LAST (and unload FIRST). unload_priority encodes this: R1..R4 = 1..4 (drained first), F1..F4 = 5..8 (drained last). The planner naturally places early-delivery cargo in R bays and final/return cargo deep in F bays.
_meta.f_r_continuity_note: Within a column, F and R are physically one open bay (no bulkhead). Modeled via the schema's front/back adjacency: R1.front=F1, F1.back=R1, etc. Each half is 2x9x2 = 36 SCU; the full column F+R is 2x18x2 = 72 SCU.
_meta.column_break_note: There is a physical break in the floor between columns 2 and 3 (between F2/R2 and F3/R3). Currently modeled as zero-width gap (cube_offset_x jumps from 2 to 4 with no zone in between). If the break turns out to be loadable as a bulk slot, add a new zone with unload_priority = 9 (absolute last resort) and shift columns 3 and 4 outward to make room.
_meta.total_scu_note: 8 bays x 36 SCU = 288 SCU, matching the catalog. The two 16 SCU pads shown in the cargo grid diagram are display-only annotations showing cubic volume; they are not separate loadable slots.

zones.notes: Forward bay, port column. Loaded FIRST (deepest) so cargo here unloads LAST — best place for return/final-destination cargo. 2x9x2 = 36 SCU.
Forward bay, mid-starboard column. Physical break in floor separates the F2/R2 column from this F3/R3 column.
Rear bay, port column. Loaded LAST (nearest ramp) so cargo here unloads FIRST — best place for early-delivery cargo. Physically continuous with F1 (no bulkhead).
Rear bay, mid-port column. Continuous with F2.
Rear bay, mid-starboard column. Continuous with F3.
Rear bay, starboard column. Continuous with F4.
